_help: Linux/macOS version (10-page turntable, same as 3d-model-iges.windows.json). IGES files, split out from 3d-model.json: f3d can't auto-detect the occt IGES reader from the .iges/.igs extension alone. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
_help_paging: 10 pages turning the model around its Z axis: --up=+Z makes Z the up axis, and %ANGLE% is 0, 36, 72 ... 324 degrees for pages 1-10 (PageUp/PageDown in Quick Look).
